code: Existing project: scaffold a react-ts project in a TEMP folder and copy its tsconfig*.json
files across (do not replace your package.json/vite.config).
Then rename files one at a time: App.jsx -> App.tsx, main.jsx -> main.tsx.
Update the <script src="/src/main.jsx"> line in index.html to main.tsx.

Migrating? Do it on a branch; one file at a time.

steps.dir: Project root (the folder that contains package.json)

troubleshooting: 'Cannot find module or its type declarations': install @types/NAME or add a declaration file.
'Object is possibly undefined/null': check first (if (!x) return) or use ?.
'Property X does not exist on type': update the interface/type that describes the object.
